subhead: New here? Follow the steps below.

single.label: Single video
single.title: How to download a video or song fast
single.description: For downloading one link at a time.
steps: Paste the video or song link into the input box.
Choose a format: MP4 HD, 4K or MP3.
Turn on Remove watermark (TikTok / Douyin only) or pick a Subtitles option if needed.
Click "Extract now", wait for processing, then download the file.
notes: TikTok / Douyin: download without watermark. Also supports YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, Spotify, SoundCloud and many more platforms.

bulk.label: Bulk download
bulk.title: How to download many links at once
bulk.description: Best when you need to process many URLs in one go.
steps: Paste multiple links (one URL per line), or load them from a .txt/.csv file.
Choose the output format for the whole list.
Click "Start bulk download"; the system processes your links in batches.
When done, download each file, copy links or download a ZIP.
notes: Best when you need videos from many different links.
Download links expire, so download right after processing finishes.

channel.label: Whole channel
channel.title: How to scan and download videos from a channel
channel.description: Use this to grab many videos from a channel, profile or playlist.
steps: Paste the channel, profile or playlist link into the input box.
Turn on Channel mode to scan the channel's videos instead of downloading a single link.
Choose how many videos to fetch: 10, 20, 50, 100, 200, 500 or enter your own.
Click "Start bulk download", follow the progress and download the results when done.
notes: Supports YouTube, TikTok, Instagram profiles and Facebook videos.
For your first run, pick 10–50 videos to check things faster.
The system processes in batches to avoid platform limits.
